name: Ticket Triage Specialist
tagline: Watches the support queue and drafts replies only when something new lands
description: Keeps an eye on the support queue at set intervals and drafts a reply for each new ticket, so agents open their shift to ready-to-send responses instead of a backlog. If the queue turns out clean it says nothing, which means the team only touches support when a human actually matters.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
